item.title: FOX One Deal: Here’s How to Save 30% Off a Streaming Subscription
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Are you ready for the FIFA World Cup in 2026? If so, you'll want to tune in to FOX, FS1, and FS2 for all the action. And right now, there's a great deal on FOX's new streaming service, FOX One.
[Short music transition]
Host: For a limited time, you can get FOX One as a Prime Video add-on channel for just $13.99 per month for three months. That's 30% off the regular price of $19.99 per month. But hurry, this deal expires at the end of the day on Friday, June 26th.
[Short music transition]
Host: Not an Amazon Prime member? No problem! You can sign up for a 30-day free trial to access Prime Video, Prime Gaming, and more. Plus, with Prime, you'll get fast free shipping, in-store discounts, and exclusive shopping events.
[Short music transition]
Host: But what if you don't want to commit to a subscription? There are other ways to watch FOX Sports online for free. Live TV streamers like DirecTV and FuboTV offer free trials and promos that'll let you catch soccer matches without cable.
[Short music transition]
Host: DirecTV is offering a five-day free trial, and their Signature Packages start at $59.99 for the first month. FuboTV also offers a five-day free trial, with prices starting at $63.99. Both options include FOX, FOX Sports, FS1, and FS2, so you can stay up-to-date on all the World Cup action.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Don't miss out on the FIFA World Cup in 2026. Sign up for FOX One or check out these other streaming options to catch all the matches. Thanks for tuning in!
